gsm8k.S_base: OPERATOR-SUPPLIED base Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct GSM8K val (VAL_BEFORE_TRAIN=False => not measured at step 0)
gsm8k.formula: C(block) = (S_block - S_base) / (0.7657 - S_base); PASS iff >= 0.80, else clean negative

bigmath.S_full: UNRECORDED (EXP-58 was a checkpoint-collection run); fallback: S_block - S_base > +0.03

cblock_provenance.note: C(block) is UNCOMPUTABLE until S_base lands. The analyst blocks on the operator-supplied S_base, never guesses.

success_criteria: All 8 matrix cells reach step 75 with no NaN/non-finite grads; step-75 val lands in wandb natively (Tracking.finish / #65).
freeze-correctness (frozen cells): TRAIN_LAYERS=11-15 => ~15% params trainable (verify via optimizer ckpt = 60 tensors / ~234M if in doubt; the logger.info marker is not captured — see memory).

Per dataset, per seed: C(block,seed) = (S_frozen - S_base)/(S_dense - S_base). Report C at seed 42 and 7 => a 2-point spread (seed error bar). PASS if C>=0.80 on BOTH seeds (block carries the RL gain) or a clean symmetric negative on both.
S_dense = the fresh dense-<dataset>-s<seed> step-75 val (GSM8K AND Big-Math now both measured natively; the old 0.7657 fixed ref + the old frozen 0.7627/0.568 are cross-checks).

clarification_needed (S_base): operator-supplied base Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct GSM8K + Big-Math val-core scores (VAL_BEFORE_TRAIN=False on all cells). Analyst plugs in per dataset; same S_base across seeds/arms.
pass_rule: PASS iff all ✓; a clean symmetric negative (C < 0.80 with gates green) is PASS.
